item.title: OnlyMarms meme coin
item.description:
It has been a crazy ride since we started OnlyMarms. The media attention has been intense and worldwide. The meme coin community discovered and loved the story so much that they decided to create a meme coin called $ONLYMARMS. The coin is now available on pump.fun and has already raised over $14K in donations for marmot research efforts.

The $ONLYMARMS coin is a fun way to support marmot conservation and research. The funds raised will go directly to the Yellow-bellied Marmot Research Project, which is dedicated to studying marmots in their natural habitats.

The $ONLYMARMS coin is a testament to the power of community and the love for marmots. We are grateful for the support and enthusiasm from the meme coin community, and we look forward to seeing how this unique initiative will continue to grow and make a positive impact on marmot conservation.
